How it works

Set up in minutes. Klo does the rest.

📲Step 1

Download and sign in

Sign in with Apple, Google or email, then turn on Face ID. Your vault stays private to you.

👨‍👩‍👧Step 2

Invite your circle, if you like

Use it on your own, or send one link to your family. Each person decides what they share.

🎙️Step 3

Say it, scan it or type it

“Add Daniel’s Omega Seamaster, bought June 2021 for $5,400.” Or scan a license, and Klo files it.

FAQ

Questions? We’ve got answers.

How is my family’s information protected?

The app and each protected stream open only with Face ID, and the Vault locks itself again after 5 minutes. Nothing is shared until you choose. Every share can be time-limited and revoked in one tap, and Recent activity shows who opened what, and when.

What is a “digital twin”?

A private, living copy of your household’s life: the trips, money, health, memories and documents that make up your week. KloneME keeps it current, and Klo watches it so reminders arrive before deadlines do.

Does Klo give medical or financial advice?

No. Klo shares information from your own records, never a diagnosis and never financial advice. It will tell you a reading is trending down or a savings goal is behind, so you can take it to your doctor or advisor.

Can my kids and parents use it?

Yes. Kids get their own accounts with parental controls. Parents and grandparents can share readings, medication lists and insurance cards with you, and with their doctor when they choose.

What happens in an emergency?

Set up Emergency share ahead of time. Press and hold for 2 seconds, and your pinned contacts can see the documents you chose for 72 hours. Klo also calls your first contact, and you can stop sharing at any moment.
